title: Poisoned (status group)
html:
This page is about the status group. For the condition, see Poisoned (Condition).

Poisoned is a status group.  Poisoned is the representative condition for the type.

Removal

The following items remove all conditions in this status group:

  • Antidote
  • Elixir of Silvanus
  • Remedial Potion
  • Herbalist's Gloves
  • Jhannyl's Gloves

The following spells/actions remove all conditions in this status group:

  • Lay on Hands
  • Lesser Restoration

Immunity

The following items grant immunity to all conditions in this status group:

  • Elixir of Poison Resistance

The following spells/actions grant immunity to all conditions in this status group:

  • Heroes' Feast
  • Feign Death

The following passive features grant immunity to all conditions in this status group:

  •  Nature's Ward
  •  Purity of Body

The following conditions grant immunity to all conditions in this status group:

  •  Mammon's Hold
  •  Sacrificial Lamb

Advantage and Disadvantage

The following items grant  Advantage on saving throws to all conditions in this status group:

  • Duergar Antidote

The following spells/actions grant  Advantage on saving throws to all conditions in this status group:

  • Protection from Poison

The following passive features grant  Advantage on saving throws to all conditions in this status group:

  •  Dwarven Resilience
  •  Strongheart Resilience

List of conditions in Poisoned

Condition Effects
Assassin's Blood
  • Creature must succeed a Constitution  Saving Throw or take 1d12⁠⁠Poison and get Poisoned until the next Long Rest.
  • On a successful save, it still takes half damage.
At Death's Door
  • The more the creature rests, the worse it feels.
At Death's Door
  • Advanced Toxic Infection. Strength, Dexterity, Constitution, Intelligence, Charisma, and Wisdom are reduced by 6. The more the creature rests, the worse it feels.
At Death's Door
  • Moderate Toxic Infection. Strength, Dexterity, Constitution, Intelligence, Charisma, and Wisdom are reduced by 4. The more the creature rests, the worse it feels.
At Death's Door
  • Emergent Toxic Infection. Strength, Dexterity, Constitution, Intelligence, Charisma, and Wisdom are reduced by 2. The more the creature rests, the worse it feels.
Auntie Ethel's Special Brew
  • The affected creature takes 2d6⁠⁠Poison at the start of every turn until passing a  DC 13 Constitution Saving Throw.
Brewed-Up Bellyglummer
  • Suffers  Disadvantage on  Attack Rolls and Ability Checks
  • Affected entity takes 1d6⁠⁠Poison damage at the end of its next turn.
Cloudkill
  • While it remains in the cloud, affected entity takes 5d8⁠⁠Poison damage every turn.
Contagion Poisoned
  • Has  Disadvantage on  Attack Rolls and Checks.
  • Each turn, it must succeed on a  Saving Throw, or the poison will advance in stage. On 3 successes, it recovers. On 3 failures, it contracts the disease corresponding to the variant of the spell Contagion that was cast.
Duergar Poison
  • A rare poison has sickened the victim.
  • Cannot perform any Actions or Reactions.
  • Automatically fails any Saving Throws.
  • All attacks against the target have  Advantage and Critical Hit if within 3 m (10 ft).
  • Immune to  Prone
Hoots' Hooch
  • A new invention of the Sharess' Caress bartender Hoots - like being decked in the sobriety.
Ingested Poisoned Beer
  • Beer mixed with a deadly toxin courses through the character's veins, slowly killing it.
  • Affected entity takes 1d6+6⁠⁠Poison damage per turn, for 10 turns.
Nauseous
  • Can't take Actions
Noxious Fumes
  • Affected entity takes 1d4⁠⁠Poison each turn. It must succeed a  DC 15 Constitution Saving Throw or take an additional 2d4⁠⁠Poison, taking half damage in a success.
Oily Sup
  • Suffers  Disadvantage on  Attack Rolls and Ability Checks.
Poisoned
  • Suffers  Disadvantage on  Attack Rolls and Ability Checks.
  • Inflicts 3d6⁠⁠Poison every turn until a successful  DC 13 Constitution Saving Throw.
Poisoned
  • Deals 3d6⁠⁠Poison per turn
  • Suffers  Disadvantage on  Attack Rolls and Ability Checks.
  • At the beginning of the turn, makes a  DC 13 Constitution Saving Throw to end the condition on success.
Poisoned
  • Suffers  Disadvantage on  Attack Rolls and Ability Checks.
  • Ends on a successful  DC 11 Constitution Saving Throw at the end of the turn.
Poisoned
  • Suffers  Disadvantage on  Attack Rolls and Ability Checks.
Poisonous Fumes
  • Takes 1d4⁠⁠Poison damage per turn.
  • Suffers  Disadvantage on Attack Rolls and Ability Checks.
Purple Worm Toxin
  • Affected entity takes 1d10⁠⁠Poison damage at the end of its next turn.
Serpent Fang Toxin
  • Affected entity takes 1d6⁠⁠Poison damage at the end of its next turn.
Sickly
  • Feeling extremely off - suspiciously so.
Simple Toxin
  • Affected entity takes 1d4⁠⁠Poison damage at the end of its next turn.
Stricken with Crawler Mucus
  • Affected entity is  Poisoned and  Paralysed
  • Lasts until affected entity has made a successful  Constitution Saving Throw.
Stricken with Drow Poison
  • Affected entity is  Poisoned and has fallen  Asleep.
  • Lasts until affected entity has made a successful  Constitution Saving Throw or takes damage.
Stricken with Malice
  • Affected entity is Blinded and Poisoned.
  • Has  Disadvantage on Attack Rolls and its range of attacks and spells is reduced to 3 m (10 ft).
  • Attack Rolls against Blinded creatures have  Advantage.
  • Suffers  Disadvantage on Ability Checks.
Tongue of Madness
  • Speaking aloud every thought, gain  Disadvantage on Charisma Checks.
Upset Stomach
  • Something was off about that apple.
  • When the duration ends, make a  DC 15 Constitution Saving Throw. Failing will inflict the condition Feverish.
Wyvern Toxin
  • Affected entity takes 1d8⁠⁠Poison damage at the end of its next turn.
